title: Nigeria Official Emergency Service Contacts Snapshot
description: A dated, privacy-safe snapshot of official Nigerian institutional emergency service contacts directly supported by primary public sources.

ncc-special-duties-service-charter.title: Nigerian Communications Commission Special Duties Department SERVICOM Charter
ncc-special-duties-service-charter.extraction_method: Manual safe extraction from the Emergency Communication Centre and Accessibility sections; full dynamic HTML was not committed.
ncc-special-duties-service-charter.stability: Byte size stable across two retrievals; full-page hash varied because the Drupal page is dynamic.

frsc-services.title: FRSC Services
frsc-services.extraction_method: Manual safe extraction from the Emergency Ambulance Service Scheme section; full HTML was not committed.

nema-flood-operations-press-release.title: FLOOD INCIDENTS: NEMA ACTIVATES OPERATIONAL OFFICES NATIONWIDE TO SUPPORT STATES, CONDUCT ASSESSMENTS
nema-flood-operations-press-release.extraction_method: Manual safe extraction from the press-release paragraph mentioning NEMA headquarters emergency contact line; full WordPress HTML was not committed.
nema-flood-operations-press-release.stability: Safe extracted paragraph was stable; full-page hash and byte size varied because the WordPress page includes dynamic content.

federal-fire-service-contact-us.title: Contact Us - Federal Fire Service Nigeria
federal-fire-service-contact-us.extraction_method: Manual safe extraction from Contact & Emergency and opening-hours text; full WordPress HTML was not committed.
federal-fire-service-contact-us.geographic_coverage: Federal Fire Service national contact page
federal-fire-service-contact-us.stability: Safe extracted contact text was stable; full-page hash and byte size varied because the WordPress page includes dynamic content.

limitations: This is a dated source-verified snapshot, not a promise that every retained contact is continuously operational.
The dataset is not a complete nationwide register of all federal, state, local, ambulance, police, fire or disaster-response emergency contacts.
State-level contacts are not included because this foundation phase retained only contacts with explicit national or nationwide evidence.
Nigeria Police Force festive press-release emergency lines were not retained because their official context appeared event-specific rather than a stable general emergency-contact register.
privacy: Only institutional public emergency contacts are retained. Personal names, personal phone numbers, personal emails, caller data, incident data, cookies and raw HTML pages are not committed.
